paper_title: Fast, Not Fancy Rethinking G2P with Rich Data and Rule-Based Models
caption: : Phase 1 (5 epochs)

model_annotations.English:
The plot illustrates the relationship between training and validation loss over a series of steps. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.200, with tick marks at 0.025 intervals. 

The “Training Loss” is represented by a blue line with circular markers and is solid. Starting at a value of approximately 0.180 at step 0, the line generally declines to 0.045 at step 30, with a local minimum of approximately 0.035 at step 10. The "Validation Loss" is represented by an orange line with circular markers and is solid. Starting at a value of approximately 0.075 at step 0, the line declines to 0.025 at step 30 with a local minimum of approximately 0.023 at step 25.

An orange line, also marked with circular data points, represents “Validation Loss” and begins at approximately 0.080 at step 0, decreasing to 0.025 at step 30, with a local minimum at approximately step 12.
